review.role: independent structural Validator precode non-Git compatibility amendment
checked: Existing supported unbound native capture can precede Git initialization; requiring Git-admin task lock breaks that API and must not be hidden by weakened tests.
One fixed per-effective-user /tmp namespace and canonical root/task key remain identical before/after Git initialization and across HOME/TMPDIR/XDG variations.
Directory0700 and lock0600 ownership/type/nofollow requirements refuse unsafe state without permission repair or environment fallback. Stable lock files never unlinked by reservation protocol.
Coordination contains no counts/mode/permission/completion authority; native/external ledgers remain sole histories and both first-reservation paths retain one owner.
Existing mixed-mode, corrupt/unknown and concurrent refusal assertions remain; independent non-Git→Git/external and environment-split controls required before repair.
Resume state locks remain Git-admin-specific and unchanged; no scope exclusions, Git auto-init, new ledger, model/network call or installed migration introduced.
limitations: Supported cooperating same-effective-user POSIX host coordination only; no cross-user/privileged-host or OS isolation claim.
Source repair, full unchanged start-path regression and independent final review remain required.
